title: VXAce Image shows only one pixel in RPG Maker VX Ace

posts.author: anecko
posts.body:
Hello everyone.
I need some help with RPG Maker VX Ace.
I’m trying to set an image for an event (Event → Graphic), but when I select the picture, only
one small pixel
appears in the graphic window instead of the full image.
You can see the problem in the screenshot: instead of the sprite, only a tiny part of the image is shown.
Could someone please explain what might be causing this and how to fix it?
Possible reasons:
wrong image size?
incorrect file format?
problem with the character grid?
or maybe I saved the image incorrectly?
I would really appreciate any help
Thank you in advance.

posts.author: DevRPG2k
posts.body:
Hello.
RPGMaker cannot interpret images on its own. You can see that every character sprite has 4 directions with 3 frames each. You can read this in the manual (Press F1 Key)

posts.body:
I once wrote an alternative tutorial for those that have problems understanding the help sections, perhaps that one is better for you:
How to create your own templates (any sprite or battler sheet)
Time and time again people who want to create their own sprites are asking for pre-made empty/framed templates because they can't work without them. And they don't even understand how limiting that is.  Templates are crutches - bad crutches to be precise, because if you need a premade template...
